description: Fetch one form's metadata: every question (id, name, type), calculations, URL parameters, scheduling and payment fields, and quiz settings. Use the question ids to read answers or to create submissions. Fillout: GET /forms/{formId}.

formId.description: The form's public id (the formId from fillout_list_forms, also the id in the form's share URL).

name: fillout_get_form
title: Get form questions and metadata
